name: the-f1-files
description: F1 history via structured SQL tools and RAG-powered natural language Q&A (1950-2024).
long_description: Combines structured SQL queries over the Ergast F1 dataset (standings, race results, qualifying, driver careers) with a RAG pipeline (Chroma + local embeddings + Groq) for open-ended natural-language questions about F1 history, grounded in retrieved context rather than the model's own training knowledge.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API Key
groq_api_key.description: Your Groq API key from console.groq.com — used by the ask_f1_question tool to generate answers.

data_directory.title: Project Data Folder
data_directory.description: Path to THE-F1-FILES 'data' folder (contains f1.db and chroma_db).

tools.name: driver_standings
tools.description: Get final or current F1 driver championship standings for a season

tools.name: constructor_standings
tools.description: Get final or current F1 constructor championship standings for a season

tools.name: race_calendar
tools.description: Get the full F1 race calendar for a season

tools.name: race_results
tools.description: Get the finishing classification for a specific F1 race

tools.name: qualifying_results
tools.description: Get qualifying results for a specific F1 race

tools.name: find_driver
tools.description: Search F1 drivers by partial name match

tools.name: driver_career_summary
tools.description: Get career totals (races, wins, podiums, points) for a driver

tools.name: ask_f1_question
tools.description: Answer open-ended natural-language questions about F1 history using RAG (semantic search + LLM generation)
